Jordan (AE): Hey @Priya — handing off Veloxum (mid-enterprise, fintech vertical). Signed last week. Key items: SSO via SAML, private VPC eval, early perf issues on 2k token prompts, trial credits expire in 38 days. Renewal risk flagged if we can't hit latency targets. Docs + notes: https://redwood.internal/veloxum-handbook (internal). Owners below, please ack and add next steps.

Jordan (AE): TL;DR owners: Priya = CSM lead, Lina = onboarding, Derek = escalation eng. Customer wanted a canary in our EU region. They may request dedicated capacity later.

Priya (CSM): Thanks Jordan — ack. I'll schedule onboarding kickoff for next Tue. Can someone paste SAML IdP metadata and current test creds? Also need a short enablement deck for their platform team.

Derek (Support Eng): Ack. FYI we saw latency regressions with quantized 8-bit on long context yesterday — file a ticket if they're reproducing. Known issue: KV cache thrash on interleaved streams, PR in review.

Derek (Support Eng): Repro steps I used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-4b-8q","input":"<~2k token payload>"}'
// observe p95 spike > 1.2s on EU-north-1
```
Attach logs: /mnt/logs/veloxum-17234.tar.gz (internal).

Priya (CSM): @Lina can you run the enablement for their infra team? Prefer Wed morning EU-ish. Also Jordan — any contractual SLAs yet?

Jordan (AE): Contract has 99.5% availability clause for dedicated rollout, nothing for hosted trial. I added a note that they expect <250ms median for short queries.

Lina (Onboarding PM): I'll run the enablement. Wed 09:30 CET works for me. I'll need an engineer for the SAML walkthrough and for the perf deep-dive — @Derek can you join?

Derek (Support Eng): I can join Wed 09:30 CET. I'll bring the perf artifacts and a short checklist to validate KV cache/hotkey behavior.

Jordan (AE): Also FYI, customer asked for data residency in EU, and encryption with their KMS. Could be multi-week for Private deployment. Marking as potential renewal risk if timeline slips.

Priya (CSM): Next steps I'm adding: 1) onboarding kickoff scheduled (Lina) 2) perf triage call + reproduce (Derek) 3) SAML metadata exchange (Jordan) 4) draft enablement deck (Lina + Derek) 5) open escalation ticket for latency (Derek). I'll own overall runbook and weekly check-ins.

ticket-bot: Created ticket REDW-8123: "Veloxum - latency repro + SAML onboarding" assigned to Support Eng team, priority P2. Link: https://jira.redwood/REDW-8123

Priya (CSM): Thanks — I'll post the onboarding calendar invite and include the customer attendees. Jordan please share IdP metadata and their internal contact (ops lead) in thread.

Jordan (AE): Sharing contact: emma.leung@veloxum.com (Ops Lead). SAML metadata: attached to the doc link above.

Lina (Onboarding PM): Quick checklist I will follow on kickoff:
- Verify SAML assertion mapping (email, org)
- Validate VPC peering request and routing
- Run perf smoke tests with sample payloads
- Capture any blocker > P1 for immediate escalation

Derek (Support Eng): I'll add the smoke test command to REDW-8123. Example: `python perf_smoke.py --model rwd-4b-8q --tokens 2000 --region eu-north-1`

Priya (CSM): Noted. I'm also going to capture their feedback template during onboarding — want to capture early quality signals to feed Optimize team.

Jordan (AE): One ask from sales: if onboarding completes smoothly we can propose Dedicated in Q3. Please flag timeline slippage asap.

Priya (CSM): Ack. I'll update the renewal risk field in Gainsight and tag Sales Ops if things slide.

Derek (Support Eng): Quick note — if their sample prompts are highly stateful we should consider prefix caching and slightly larger KV caches; I'll propose config in the ticket.

Priya (CSM): Great — thanks team. I'll follow up with the invite and weekly cadence. Closing initial handoff here — react with :white_check_mark: when you've read and accepted action items.

Jordan (AE): :white_check_mark:

Derek (Support Eng): :white_check_mark:

Lina (Onboarding PM): :white_check_mark:
